refused.message:
refusal[ESS-SYNTH-012]: entity metrics.session.Session has no scenario `metrics.session.Session/state/Completed/refuses/metrics.session.Complete`
  `metrics.session.Complete` on a `metrics.session.Session` in `Completed` is refused and the specification does not say how: no `wrong_state:` outcome and no declared error, so the scenario can only require that nothing happened
  help: give the command a `wrong_state:` outcome naming the error it reports; the states it answers in are already declared, as the states its transitions do not run from

metrics.session.Complete/outcome/complet.purpose: `metrics.session.Complete` answers `completed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

metrics.session.QueueTotals/aggregate.purpose: `metrics.session.QueueTotals` reports every group's exact aggregates over rows this scenario made, and no empty group

metrics.session.Record/outcome/recorded.purpose: `metrics.session.Record` answers `recorded` for an input no other branch's guard claims

metrics.session.Session/state/Completed/.purpose: `metrics.session.Complete` does not move a `metrics.session.Session` that is in `Completed`
